name: Default
shortDescription: Node.js forum software with real-time discussions, chat, notifications and ActivityPub federation, backed by PostgreSQL with persistent uploads and plugins.

alerts.message: The first start runs the setup, builds the assets and restarts the container once, which takes a few minutes. Sign in with the admin account it creates: the username is NODEBB_ADMIN_USERNAME and the generated password is NODEBB_ADMIN_PASSWORD in the environment settings. Change the admin email in your profile afterwards.
Configure an email service under Admin > Settings > Email, otherwise users cannot receive confirmation and password reset emails.
